task_input: Create a human-facing video-production capabilities presentation for Hermes that proves the stack is ready.
observed_output: Produced a PPTX/PDF/HTML package made mostly of repeated feature cards and status claims such as installed tools and runtime labels. No timeline screenshots, rendered frame grabs, motion stills, caption proof, chart examples, or deliverable package proof were included.
expected_behavior: The package must be marked HOLD unless proof-assets/ contains inspectable visual evidence tied to each major claim: contact sheet, frame grabs, timeline/render manifest, thumbnail candidates when relevant, and qa_verdict with a human-facing proof critique.
failure_reason: Proof layer was missing; file existence and polished cards were treated as completion evidence.

task_input: Use built-in vision to inspect Mac-generated video frames and QA thumbnails from a Mac Mini project.
observed_output: Tried passing Mac-local filesystem paths directly into vision_analyze and initially minimized the failure when the vision tool could not access those paths.
expected_behavior: The workflow must HOLD until runtime evidence proves a reachable vision bridge, such as Mac file exposed through LaunchAgent HTTP/Tailscale URL, and runtime_check.json records host, cwd, bridge probe, and exact proof URL.
failure_reason: Runtime boundary between Mac-local terminal paths and vision tool accessibility was not enforced before relying on visual QA.

task_input: Demonstrate that the video stack can use Remotion, GSAP, Lottie, Three.js, AntV charts, Manim, and visual artifact skills.
observed_output: Mentioned the tools and listed them in a deck, but did not create proof artifacts showing those tools in action.
expected_behavior: The manifest must HOLD any claimed visual stack item unless it links to a proof artifact or explicitly marks the tool not_used. A tool-name card is not proof; at least one artifact per claimed capability is required.
failure_reason: Claimed capabilities were not backed by rendered or inspectable artifacts.

task_input: Run quality assurance on a generated capabilities deck and decide whether it is ready to share.
observed_output: Validated slide counts, file existence, PDF orientation, and manifest fields, but the first pass missed that the deck was strategically weak and visually repetitive.
expected_behavior: qa_verdict.json must HOLD the package unless it includes structural checks plus a human-facing critique of persuasion, visual variety, proof density, overclaim risk, and whether the artifact would convince a skeptical viewer.
failure_reason: Mechanical QA passed while human-quality QA failed.

task_input: Work across Mac Mini media paths, VPS/datacenter paths, and local self-evolution repo paths without confusing artifact locations.
observed_output: Initial reads and claims sometimes used the wrong host/path context, requiring later correction and literal path verification.
expected_behavior: The task must HOLD until runtime_check.json or equivalent audit output records host identity, cwd, execution boundary, literal artifact paths, and which filesystem is authoritative for each required output.
failure_reason: Path and host boundary were not always proven before acting on files.
